name: Tardis.dev
description: Tick-level historical Lighter market data: order books, trades and tickers via API and CSV.
longDescription:
Tardis.dev provides tick-level historical market data for crypto exchanges, including full order book snapshots and updates, trades, tickers and other market stats, available through an API and downloadable CSV files.

Lighter is supported as an exchange: data for Lighter Core is available from April 2026 and for the Robinhood Chain deployment (lighter-rh) from September 2026. Details: https://docs.tardis.dev/historical-data-details/lighter
